title: Needs to be a Few Inches Longer
text: Needs to be a Few Inches Longer. For use on a two burner Coleman stove it needs to be a few inches longer.  The gas flames flare up over the edges even when the stove is on low.  If it wasn't for that it would be the perfect griddle.  Very light weight.  Easy to clean.  Just too short for a Coleman two burner stove.
